thread:
deploy-bot: Rolling deploy started for embed-service: v3.4.1 -> v3.5.0. Strategy=gradual (10% -> 100%), change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Watch SLOs: https://dash.internal/redwood/embed-service/canary  

alice: watching the canary dash now, will flag if p95/err rate move. tagging @oncall-sre 

ben: infra-alerts: emb-generate-error-rate firing in channel infra-alerts (threshold 0.5%). seeing a bump. 

oncall-sre: saw the alert. p95 for /v1/generate jumped 240ms -> 560ms at ~22:11 UTC. p50 unchanged. 

sara: quick check — p95 spike correlates with longer sequences, but also higher memory alloc on those hosts. trying to repro locally. 

carlos: can we pause the rollout and pin traffic for /v1/generate to v3.4.1 while we investigate? low blast radius preferred. 

alice: agree. pinning route now: `rdctl route pin embed-service /v1/generate --version v3.4.1` 

deploy-bot: Route pin executed by alice at 1782345665. Rollout paused at 20% across us-west-2. 

ben: error rate jumped from 0.12% -> 0.85% over 5m on canary instances, error class mostly 502s from runtime gateway. sample logs attached in infra-alert thread. 

oncall-sre: sampled logs show GC/alloc pressure then grpc timeouts. snippet: ```[2026-02-15T22:11:23Z] infer: mem used 14.9GB/16GB; eviction start; backend grpc timeout```. looks like quantized kernels allocate more peak memory on long sequences. 

sara: repro by running `tox --seq 4096 --q8` hits same OOM pattern locally. filing TODO to add a memory guard in runtime. 

carlos: for immediate safety can we adjust canary SLO thresholds back a bit to avoid noisy alerts, or should we leave them strict? 

oncall-sre: do not lower SLOs just to silence. Instead adjusting alerting policy to include a 2m suppression for consecutive spikes might reduce churn. opened infra-alerts PR to add a short suppress window. 

release-notes-bot: Release notes updated: v3.5.0 marked as "deferred: generator memory optimization" for /v1/generate. https://notes.internal/releases/embed-service/v3.5.0 

alice: decision: keep rollout paused, pin remains in place for /v1/generate, proceed with non-generator routes (embedding endpoints) to 100% since they are healthy. leaving canary for generate at v3.4.1. 

ben: agreed. creating follow-up issue: INC-3427 with logs, repro steps, and suggested runtime memory cap. assigning to eng-runtime. 

oncall-sre: will keep monitoring for 30m after pin. if error rate doesn't fall back to baseline we'll consider rollback of the whole release. current plan: wait 30m, if stable — continue partial rollout for unaffected routes, else full rollback to v3.4.1. 

sara: started a small experiment patch to cap batch size for q8 path; will share a patch set in PR 6789. 

carlos: thanks. @alice can you update the customer-facing release notes to reflect the partial pin and note a targeted hotfix next week? 

alice: will update release notes and add a short blurb in #product-updates. 

oncall-sre: monitoring note: added temporary dashboard panel for v3.5.0 canary hosts to track GPU mem usage and grpc error rate side-by-side. link: https://dash.internal/redwood/embed-service/canary/mem-vs-errs 

ben: alert suppression PR merged, should reduce noise while we triage. 

oncall-sre: last check — error rate trending down to 0.18% after pin but p95 still slightly elevated on a couple hosts. continuing watch. 

alice: thanks everyone. follow-up: ENG-RUNTIME to prepare hotfix, ENG-RELEASE to schedule a restricted rollout once memory fix lands. closing thread in 1h if stable. :thumbsup:
